title: Unramified normalization stalks after the group-order root extension
statement: Let i:U -> L and W -> U be a finite etale G-torsor, G finite. Let phi:Spec R -> L, f in R, and an isomorphism beta:U times_L Spec R = D(f) compatible with the maps to Spec R. Let H be a commutative Noetherian R-algebra via b, put g=b(f) and n=|G|, assume n is invertible in H, multiplication by g is injective, and H/(g) is a domain. Set A=H[t]/(t^n-g), N=Spec A and V=D(g). Assume prime localizations containing t are regular local and N is locally Noetherian. Pull the given torsor back to V, obtaining p; assume p finite etale and its relative normalization over N finite. Let j:D -> N be a regular integral effective Cartier centre with image N minus V. At each normalization point x over j(eta), eta generic in D, the normalization stalk map is formally unramified. No flatness or open-neighbourhood conclusion is part of this assertion.

source.place: Tags 09EB (Galois DVR degree formula), 0BRM (Abhyankar lemma), 0EYG (root-extension paragraph), 0307 (localization), and 02GF (local unramified criterion).

proof.text: Apply the maximal-ideal equality clause at the given normalization point.

Apply the residue-separability clause at the same point. The scheme residue map and the residue map of the local stalk algebra agree: test their algebra maps on the surjective residue map, where the equality is definitional.

Finiteness of fromNormalization gives locally finite type, and LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap gives essential finite type of the stalk algebra. The stalk map is local. Apply Mathlib Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_map_maximalIdeal with the separability instance and the ideal equality, then read it as RingHom.FormallyUnramified. This is the complete private helper and combination proof in the Lean module.

theorem root_normalization_generic_stalk_unramified
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (b : R ⟶ H)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : H)) (hg : IsSMulRegular H (b.hom f))
    [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})] :
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    (∀ (Q : Ideal A) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
      letI := hQ
      AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g) ∈ Q →
        IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)) →
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    letI := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    letI := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N),
      IsRegular D → IsIntegral D → IsEffectiveCartierCenter j →
      (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) →
      ∀ (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ →
      ∀ (x : a.normalization), a.fromNormalization x = j η →
        (a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom.FormallyUnramified
